name: Biomimicry
descriptionTemplate: {Embryo Fusion} +[Blood:Arg1]. The lower the current HP, the stronger the effect, up to +100%. Gain 1 stack of {Gynoecium}.
lore:
In her process of mimicking humanity, Saya's insatiable curiosity and extraordinary ability to learn allowed her to gain a soul uncannily akin to that of a human girl.
And so she grew lonelier than ever, yet happier than ever.
